name: converge-loop
description: Run multi-agent deliberation loops that debate, negotiate, and converge on any decision, design, or artifact.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent debate and convergence for any decision, design, or artifact
interface.longDescription: Use converge-loop to orchestrate constructive back-and-forth between agents, gather evidence, surface pushback, and converge on a shared conclusion or a clear unresolved decision point. The engine is subject-agnostic: architecture designs, product tradeoffs, quick either/or decisions, or any artifact the caller supplies.
defaultPrompt: Have two agents debate this decision
Use converge-loop to pressure-test this design
Find pushback and better ideas for this artifact
